name: Italian Supreme Court of Cassation, Joint Divisions, order no. 5668/2023 – PM10 Milan (jurisdiction)

jurisdiction.court: Italian Supreme Court of Cassation, Joint Civil Divisions

description: Negative conflict of jurisdiction raised by the Regional Administrative Court for Lombardy (TAR Lombardia) (order no. 1208/2022) after the Tribunal of Milan (judgment no. 3364/2021) had declined jurisdiction over the claim for damages brought by a Milanese citizen against the Municipality of Milan and the Lombardy Region for damage to health caused by the persistent exceedances of the PM10 limits found by the CJEU in judgment C-644/18.
outcome: The Joint Divisions affirmed the jurisdiction of the ordinary court, on the premise that the protection of the right to health has the nature of a subjective right “not degradable” to a legitimate interest, even where the omission of administrative measures is invoked. A decision of systemic significance for compensatory clean air litigation in Italy.
